data.name: Allamanda Beach Resort
data.address: Grand Anse Beach, Grand Anse, Grenada
data.description:
In a series of modern, pastel-colored buildings, this relaxed hotel overlooking Grand Anse Beach is 5 km from Maurice Bishop International Airport and 7 km from the National Cricket Stadium in St George's.
Featuring tile floors and vibrant design accents, the casual rooms offer balconies, free Wi-Fi and satellite TV, as well as minifridges, and tea and coffeemakers. Some have ocean views.
There's an outdoor pool, a spa, a fitness room and a tennis court.
